question: What did Utpala teach about intrinsic differences among things?
premises: Utpala is cited as an authority.
Existent and nonexistent are compared with inert and non-inert.
No intrinsic difference in own nature is affirmed.
inference: It is ascertained that such pairs have no intrinsic difference in their own nature.
plain_english: As the teacher Utpala said, just as there is no intrinsic difference in the own nature of existent and nonexistent things, so too there is none for inert and non-inert things; this is ascertained.
